question: Measure the anonymous rate limit of https://mcp.parallel.ai/mcp with a probe that sends POST JSON-RPC (initialize, tools/list, then repeated web_search calls) and register its record with --probe.
why: The unmeasured half of queue item 20261030-1045-expand-crawler-scraper-47c4-u03-q01: the vendor publishes no anonymous limit ('lower rate limits'), and probe.py sends only GET and HEAD while the route takes POST, so only the GET answers were measured (405 on /mcp, 401 on /mcp?login). The legacy Search MCP docs say the session_id argument is used for free-tier rate limiting, and the vendor's setup skill says sustained use answers HTTP 429. A POST probe would find the 429 threshold, its Retry-After, and whether a new session_id resets it.
